name: Golden Designs Klosters 6-Person Barrel Traditional Sauna
description: Klosters 6-Person Barrel Traditional Sauna - Pacific Cedar The Golden Designs Klosters 6-Person Barrel Traditional Sauna in Pacific Cedar is a luxurious outdoor sauna designed to enhance your wellness experience and add a touch of elegance to your backyard. This barrel-shaped sauna is crafted to maximize usable space while minimizing excess cubic feet, ensuring efficient and rapid heating. Here are the standout features of this exceptional sauna: With a Golden Designs traditional barrel sauna, you can turn that dream of your very own home spa into a reality. Now with our outdoor barrel sauna, you can place it anywhere in your yard, avoiding taking up any space in your home. Enjoy the health benefits a traditional sauna brings to your life. Take the first step to a healthier life! Includes Interior backrest with accent lighting Sandglass thermometer bucket and scoop Harvia "WALL" Stove 8KW Traditional Sauna Stove with Built-in Controls Features Delivery: This item will be delivered curbside only on a pallet by a freight carrier. Capacity: Full 6-person capacity Stove: 8.0 kW Stove with built-in controls Wood Type: Pacific Premium Cedar wood construction Glass: Bronze Privacy Tempered glass door Interior backrest with accent light Control Panels: Interior LED Control Panel for accent lighting Accessories: Sandglass, bucket, and scoop Temperature Range: Traditional Stove: 170-185 is the ideal temperature range, sauna can heat up to 190F Electrical service: 240V / 40AMP (Stove) and 120V / 15AMP (Control for Lights and Music) (Please consult a certified electrician.) Location: Outdoor Use Spacious Interior: Accommodating up to six people, the barrel design provides ample space for users to relax and enjoy the therapeutic benefits of sauna bathing. The ergonomic seating ensures comfort, making it ideal for social gatherings or solitary relaxation. Pacific Cedar Construction: Made from premium Pacific Cedar, this sauna boasts natural resistance to decay and insects. The rich, aromatic wood not only adds to the aesthetic appeal but also enhances the overall sauna experience with its pleasant scent and smooth finish. Efficient Heating: The unique barrel shape reduces excess cubic feet, allowing the sauna to heat quickly and maintain a consistent temperature. This design ensures that heat is evenly distributed throughout the interior, providing a soothing and effective sauna session. Outdoor Ready: The Klosters sauna is designed to withstand the elements, making it perfect for creating an outdoor paradise. Whether placed in your garden, on a deck, or by a pool, this sauna seamlessly integrates into any outdoor setting, adding both beauty and functionality. Traditional Sauna Experience: Embrace the authentic sauna experience with the Klosters' traditional heating system, which offers adjustable temperatures to suit your preferences. The natural heat promotes detoxification, improves circulation, and alleviates stress, providing a holistic approach to health and wellness. Easy Assembly: The sauna is designed for straightforward assembly, with pre-cut and pre-fabricated components that simplify the installation process. Clear instructions and all necessary hardware are included, ensuring you can enjoy your sauna with minimal hassle.
